research_question: Can a smaller local model judge whether already-proposed VRM calls are explicitly authorized without the lexical overfitting and recall loss observed in V34?

v34_diagnosis.root_cause: The V34 validator required hand-written positive lexical cues. It safely removed many false actions but also rejected valid colloquial requests.
v34_diagnosis.forbidden_fix: Do not add the failed holdout phrases to a synonym or regex list.

role_boundary.action_proposer: Produces zero or more structured VRM calls from the user utterance.
role_boundary.semantic_authorizer: Judges each already-proposed call against the utterance. It cannot create, replace, or repair a call.
role_boundary.deterministic_validator: Checks allowlisted schema, complete verdict coverage, exact evidence provenance, and duplicate calls.

development_evidence.reuse_disclosure: Labels and failures are already known. This run may select an architecture and candidate but cannot confirm or authorize runtime use.

selection_rule: Advance the smallest candidate that passes every gate for both frozen proposal sources. A larger candidate advances only if every smaller candidate fails. Passing development permits only a newly authored frozen holdout.

failure_response.small_models_reject_valid_calls: The narrow semantic task still exceeds that capacity or the contract is unclear; advance one size without adding phrase-specific examples.
failure_response.small_models_allow_non_requests: Separate utterance-state classification from per-call entailment and retest on a new development version.
failure_response.all_models_fail_in_the_same_cases: Inspect the proposer/tool schema boundary rather than scaling the authorizer.
failure_response.development_passes_but_fresh_confirmatio: Reject promotion as overfitting and start a new version with untouched wording.
